title: ProposalVersion
description: One immutable snapshot of a proposal's content and policy evaluation. Append-only — never mutated after creation.

content.description: Structured, human-reviewable description of the proposed action.

uncertainty_statement.description: Present when the outcome cannot be determined with confidence. Surfaced to the human reviewer.

resource_version.description: Provider resource version at prepare time. Used for stale detection on approval.

policy_outcome.description: Output of the policy gate at prepare time.

revised_by.description: User ID if this version was created by a human revision. Null if created by the agent.
